## Why GPL-3.0-or-later

The plugin statically links CommonLibOB64 (https://github.com/libxse/commonlibob64) and its commonlib-shared
library (https://github.com/libxse/commonlib-shared), both GPL-3.0. It draws its settings page through Apocrypha Menu
Framework's own Dear ImGui context (the framework's MIT header, `AMF.h`).

The conversation camera follows the method of Ultimate Combat's lock-on (Kramer7046), whose permissions allow
modification with credit; no file of it is included.

Components under other licences, with their notices: `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
